duplicate_percent.scope: immutable trusted live execution observations; excludes explicit deliberate retries and lease recovery; uninstrumented/unclassified records prevent a passing claim

query_latency_ms.scope: interactive query target; server and end-to-end measurements must remain separate
query_latency_ms.baseline_acceptance: Diagnostic sample only; production Grafana verification required after deployment

cadence.monitor: hourly, read-only GitHub metadata plus append-only operational sample; no fixture scheduling
cadence.performance: release or manual; no daily-ingestion SLA
